name: Hierarchical Clustering
learningObjectives: Understand agglomerative and divisive hierarchical clustering
Learn about linkage criteria (single, complete, average, Ward)
Explore dendrograms for visualizing cluster hierarchies
Recognize how to determine optimal number of clusters
Understand the computational complexity of hierarchical methods

controls.label: Number of Clusters
controls.tooltip: Number of clusters to form by cutting the dendrogram

controls.label: Linkage Method
controls.tooltip: Method to calculate distance between clusters

visualizations.title: Cluster Assignments
visualizations.description: Scatter plot showing data points colored by cluster

visualizations.title: Dendrogram
visualizations.description: Tree diagram showing hierarchical cluster relationships

metrics.name: Silhouette Score
metrics.description: Measure of how similar points are to their own cluster vs. other clusters (-1 to 1, higher is better)

metrics.name: Davies-Bouldin Score
metrics.description: Average similarity between clusters (lower is better)

metrics.name: Calinski-Harabasz Score
metrics.description: Ratio of between-cluster to within-cluster variance (higher is better)
